scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run py:check
scripts.firmware:test: cmake -S firmware/core -B firmware/core/build -G Ninja && cmake --build firmware/core/build && ctest --test-dir firmware/core/build --output-on-failure
scripts.firmware:format: clang-format -i firmware/core/include/charm/*.h firmware/core/src/*.cpp firmware/core/src/ui/*.cpp firmware/core/src/ui/*.h firmware/core/tests/*.cpp firmware/core/tests/*.h
scripts.firmware:format:check: clang-format --dry-run --Werror firmware/core/include/charm/*.h firmware/core/src/*.cpp firmware/core/src/ui/*.cpp firmware/core/src/ui/*.h firmware/core/tests/*.cpp firmware/core/tests/*.h
scripts.firmware:sim: emcmake cmake -S firmware/sim -B firmware/sim/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build firmware/sim/build && tsx firmware/sim/package-sim.ts
